data.description:
## Context / Problem
The Windows sweep on main at `13210300d78` (scheduled run 44649102885, job `sweep (windows)` 135999196974, 2026-11-19 16:51 PST) fails `tests/unit/test_identity_ts3_117b.py::test_off_keyring_signature_fails_enforcement`. The test arrived with `9a6ed375112` (starving-sphalerite-skua); the previous dispatch on main, run 44621093373 at `0fec72331c4`, had no failure.

The child prints `verify-identity: FAIL — 1 enforced in-scope event(s) are not verified`. The CLI writes UTF-8 on every platform: `_use_utf8_stdio` in `src/rebar/_cli/__init__.py:321` reconfigures stdout to UTF-8. The test's `_verify_authorship` helper (`tests/unit/test_identity_ts3_117b.py:130-141`) runs the CLI with `text=True` and no `encoding`, so the parent decodes with the locale codec: cp1252 on Windows turns the em dash (UTF-8 `E2 80 94`) into `â€”`, and the assertion `"FAIL — 1 …" in combined` fails. The log shows exactly that: the expected literal renders as one byte, the actual text as three.

Reproduced on macOS by forcing a non-UTF-8 locale codec: `LC_ALL=en_US.ISO8859-1 PYTHONUTF8=0 PYTHONCOERCECLOCALE=0 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_identity_ts3_117b.py` fails exactly this test (1 failed, 13 passed); under the default UTF-8 locale all 14 pass.

## Approach
Decode the CLI child's output as UTF-8 in the test, matching the CLI's documented stdio contract (the same pattern `tests/unit/test_windows_text_encoding.py` checks for product parents). Add `encoding="utf-8"` to every text-mode `subprocess.run` in `tests/unit/test_identity_ts3_117b.py` that starts the rebar CLI (the helpers at `:81`, `:136`, `:337` and the call at `:490`). The `ssh-keygen -lf` call at `:228` prints ASCII and also gets `encoding="utf-8"` so the module has no locale-decoded call left.

## Scope
- `tests/unit/test_identity_ts3_117b.py`

## Testing
The forced-locale reproduction above passes after the change (14 passed). The module passes under the normal UTF-8 locale. `make verify` passes. A `sweep (windows)` run on main after merge shows this test passing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `LC_ALL=en_US.ISO8859-1 PYTHONUTF8=0 PYTHONCOERCECLOCALE=0 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_identity_ts3_117b.py` reports 0 failures on macOS.
- [ ] `make verify` passes on the change.
- [ ] A `sweep (windows)` run on main after the merge does not list `test_off_keyring_signature_fails_enforcement` among its failures (run id recorded in a comment).
data.title: Windows sweep: test_off_keyring_signature_fails_enforcement decodes the rebar CLI's UTF-8 output with the locale codec
